description: Where a SaaSCity submission stands. By claim token: unclaimed, expired, claimed but the form not submitted yet, submitted and waiting for payment, submitted and in review, not_selected (declined for the free Editorial Pool, eligible to upgrade to a paid plan), rejected, archived, scheduled, or live. By slug: a public live listing (launch week, link type, points).

claim_token.description: Token from submit_project (the mcp_... part of the claim URL)

name: get_submission_status

state.description: claimed_not_submitted: the human opened the claim link but has not submitted the form. awaiting_payment: the selected plan still needs payment. claimed_in_review: the listing is waiting for manual review. not_selected: not selected for the free Editorial Pool (paid plans remain available). scheduled: approved for a future launch Monday.

title: Get submission status
